finding.zhCn: 创始团队存在代币经济权益，但个人完整数量和钱包未知

finding.zhCn: 公司股权与网络供应、基金会国库必须分开
finding.en: Company equity must be separated from network supply and Foundation treasury

finding.zhCn: 具有核心技术影响力，但不能单方面控制验证者网络
finding.en: Has core technical influence but cannot unilaterally control the validator network

claim.en: Conceived Solana and Proof of History

finding.zhCn: 错误；Greg Fitzgerald、Stephen Akridge、Raj Gokal等共同参与
